title: Untitled (Cross and Discs)
description: Dense mixed-media collage built around a large black cross dominating the vertical center, surrounded by compact discs, target motifs, and layered paper fragments. Red horizontal bands intersect the composition, with a photographic face visible at right and gold-leaf elements at lower left.
composition: vertical cross anchors layered disc and target elements
keywords: black cross collage with compact discs
